rules: Oracle access is limited to Codex-A, Claude read-only and Codex-B for instrument validation.
Every oracle access must record operator, session, timestamp, pinned commit and purpose.
Validators with oracle access are permanently ineligible to operate a future blind held-out resolver run.
Oracle content must not be copied into prompts, logs or reports beyond hashes and aggregate structural facts.
No future resolver operator may receive oracle-derived validation fixture details.
Custody closes on authorization consumption regardless of outcome.
claim_limit: Protocol design is not evidence that custody has been correctly executed.
